value.rationale: This is a complete fourteen-order exact profile for the shortest cyclic superstring of the natural tribonacci-growth language of words without three zeroes in a row. Unlike ordinary de Bruijn sets the required directed graph is unbalanced from order four, so repetitions are mathematically unavoidable. The primal-dual certificates quantify their sharp cost and the matching witnesses establish an additional nontrivial constrained-optimum property: forbidden windows are not needed in any of the fourteen optimal constructions. It is a reusable finite benchmark rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or routine recomputation of a published table.
